part.text: {"items":[{"index":1,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Keep the daily recurrence exactly but vectorize the state update over thousands of parameter sets or catchments on a GPU","reason":"Daily time-step dependency is kept; parallelism only runs independent parameter sets side by side."},{"index":2,"kind":"copies","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Replace one long chain with hundreds of independent chains launched together on a GPU","reason":"Independent chains are copies run side by side; each chain's iterations still wait sequentially."},{"index":3,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"yes","quote":"At each step evaluate k candidate proposals from the current state in parallel on the GPU, then combine them via a statistically valid multi-proposal Metropolis-Hastings update","reason":"Proposals no longer wait on the current accept/reject decision; they are evaluated simultaneously and combined validly."},{"index":4,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"Build a GPU neural surrogate mapping parameters to likelihood values or summary signatures from offline simulator runs","reason":"Changes what is computed (approximate surrogate), but sequential steps are bypassed, not computed simultaneously; MCMC stays sequential."},{"index":5,"kind":"reframe","meets_criterion":"no","quote":"run HMC or NUTS on GPU with multiple leapfrog trajectories in parallel, taking fewer sequential steps to reach the same effective sample size","reason":"Fewer sequential steps, but chain transitions still wait on each other; parallel trajectories are side-by-side copies."}]}
